_comment: SYNTHETIC example manifest for the P2 fidelity harness. Copy it and point the
paths at a real report working dir OUTSIDE this repo. NEVER commit a manifest
that embeds real chart paths tied to WHO strain data or, worse, chart contents.
Charts + reference PDFs are always referenced by PATH; nothing real is committed.
Top-level keys (all optional): width (native render width, default = raster_size),
out_dir (output dir; default a scratch dir). 'maps' is the list of entries.
Per-entry keys: chart (required, path to styled .ace), style (required, a c["R"]
front-style name e.g. clades-v1 / serology / ts-YYYY-MM / info-clades-v1),
golden (kateri reference PDF path; 'auto' derives <dir>/out.1.<style>.pdf; omit to
skip), ad_ref (AD single-map reference PDF path; omit when AD is only page-embedded),
